self_assessment: Added the feature_qr_signin_reciprocate_show experimental setting (LabGroup.Experimental, LEVELS_FEATURE, default false) with the display name 'Allow a QR code to be shown in session manager to sign in another device' and the description 'Requires your server to support MSC3882 and MSC3886', plus both strings in en_EN.json. LoginWithQRSection now imports SettingsStore and computes offerShowQr as the setting value AND the MSC3882/MSC3886 unstable_features, so it renders null whenever the flag is off regardless of server support; when both hold it still renders the 'Sign in with QR code' subsection with the 'Show QR code' button, whose click drives the existing LoginWithQR flow (already exposing data-testid=login-with-qr via LoginWithQRFlow). SessionManagerTab imports SettingsStore and only renders the section when the flag is set, and SecurityUserSettingsTab guards its own render of the section the same way, so neither tab presents the QR option unless the feature is explicitly enabled. Verified: standalone tsc over the four changed files reports no errors before or after, and a scratch render of the real LoginWithQRSection (transpiled, with stubbed languageHandler/SettingsStore/UI components) confirmed all five cases - flag off with full server support, flag unset, flag on with only MSC3882, flag on with no versions at all, and flag on with both MSCs producing the heading and the Show QR code action. jest could not run because matrix-js-sdk is a github: dependency and the proxy blocks codeload.github.com.
